title: Exotic Crisp Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A sweet and crisp Moroccan dish featuring cinnamon and beurre-monte, made in a hot pot vessel and suitable for plant-based diets with substitutions, this exotic tagine is a meal prep dream come true.

ingredients.name: cinnamon sticks
ingredients.notes: ground cinnamon can be used as substitute

instructions: Preheat the hot pot vessel to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb shoulder, cinnamon sticks, and beurre-monte until the lamb is well coated.
Add the diced onions, carrots, and chopped apricots to the bowl and mix until they are evenly distributed.
Add the chickpeas and vegetable broth to the bowl and stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to the preheated hot pot vessel and cook for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the lid and let the tagine crisp up for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve the exotic crisp Moroccan lamb tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the tagine cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for meal prep.
Reheat the tagine to an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit before serving.
